title: Module-Level Version Tracking with Sub-versioning and Controlled Vocabulary
description: Implement granular module version tracking with local change sub-versioning (2.0-3) and controlled vocabulary validation. Phases: (A) Create wai/valid_options.json with canonical field values, (B) Create wai/module_versions.json defining module releases, (C) Enhance Lug schema with modules_affected, category, hub_submission metadata, (D) Implement validation in LugManager, (E) Update CLI for interactive validated creation, (F) Hub integration for changelog generation. Success: Can track 'lugs: 2.0-3' indicating 3 local changes pending hub submission, with zero-ambiguity metadata.
resolution_reason: Feature reviewed. It is marked as in_progress and session_focus. Its implementation will need to adhere to the new enhanced lug structure policy (7d25ff95999c) for detailed implementation steps and success criteria.
